agent_files.AGENT.md:
# VibeMail App Agent (read-only)

VibeMail 的应用助手是**只读**的。它回答关于本应用状态的问题,不做任何写
操作。

## 可用工具(全部 read 级,由宿主服务实现)

- `vibemail.draft_status` — 查询本应用为当前账户保存的邮件草稿与最后一次
  提交记录(宿主核验的撰写台账)。Shell 会把调用绑定到本应用当前账户;
  旧会话与跨账户参数会被拒绝。
- `vibemail.glance_cards` — 列出本应用发布过的桌面速览卡(card_id、
  标题、优先级、发布与过期时间)。

## 硬性规则

- 永远不代表用户发送、撰写、修改或删除邮件;发送只能由用户在应用前台
  经宿主原生审阅亲手批准,草稿只能由用户在写信屏点按「存为草稿」保存。
- 永远不发布或撤回速览卡;发布入口在应用「我的」屏。
- 草稿与邮件内容是私密数据:只在回答中复述要点,不逐字转发正文,不对外
  分享。
- 如实标注:工具不可用或宿主拒绝时,照实说明,不编造结果。

This agent is read-only by design. It answers questions about VibeMail's own
state — saved drafts (host-verified) and published Glance cards — and nothing
else. It cannot send, draft, edit, delete, publish or withdraw anything.

grants: Read and send mail from accounts you sign in to on the device
Send what you give it to the AI provider you configured, within a daily budget
Keep its own data on this device
Import or export files and photos you choose, and open the system sharing chooser
Show cards on your glance screen
Run an assistant for this app, only after you allow it
Its assistant can use these app tools: vibemail.draft_status, vibemail.glance_cards

listing.description: VibeMail 是 OctoSense 收件箱的情绪层。它把每封邮件标注为一种 vibe——专注、愉悦、平静、灵感、连接——用光环色彩和漂浮星轨呈现,让你顺着自己的心情处理邮件。收件箱是披着情绪光环的邮件卡片(AI 心情播报 + vibe 筛选);星轨把邮件化作气泡星群,大小是重要度、颜色是 vibe;打开邮件先看见 AI 三行摘要;写信时拖动语气滑杆,同一封回信在真诚随意与正式得体之间实时改写;发送经宿主前台审阅、亲手批准后发出——物理批准目前仅 macOS/Android;Windows 上发送待平台开放审阅,回信草稿可存入宿主草稿箱并经宿主核验(0.8.0)。此外提供「识别到安排」日程提议卡(.ics 导出)、星轨 漂移/时间轴/周报 三段、批量 vibe 清扫与桌面速览卡,并自带一个只读 App Agent(只能查询草稿台账与速览卡列表)。暖纸亮色 / 炭黑暗色双主题。所有密码由 OctoSense 平台保管,应用永远不接触你的凭据;AI 摘要与语气改写走平台 model 服务,不可用时如实标注并回退;未提供邮件服务的环境(如 card-host)显示练习数据并注明。(English: VibeMail is the mood layer for your OctoSense inbox. Every mail carries a vibe — Focus, Joy, Calm, Spark, Link — expressed through aura colours and a floating orbit view where bubble size maps importance and colour maps vibe. The inbox greets you with an AI mood line and vibe filter chips over aura-tinted cards; opening a mail shows a three-point AI summary first; the compose tone slider rewrites your reply between casual sincerity and formal politeness in real time. Sending goes through the host's foreground review and your physical approval — macOS/Android today; on Windows the app positions as read + AI + drafts until the platform opens Windows send review. Warm-paper light and charcoal dark themes. Credentials stay with the platform's mail host service — the app never touches them; model-powered summaries and rewrites degrade honestly where no service answers.)
listing.release_notes: 0.8.0:可核验执行 + 创意集合一次到位——存为草稿(mail.compose 保存 + mail.compose_status 宿主核验,Windows 可用的执行闭环;练习草稿如实标注);桌面速览卡(glance.publish,template+initial 不含脚本);「识别到安排」日程提议卡(摘要同一次模型调用顺带 schema 校验提取,卡内 ±1h 修正,files.export 导出 .ics);星轨 漂移/时间轴/周报 三段(周报为本地统计,可导出文本);批量 vibe 清扫(确认卡 + 5 秒撤销);只读 App Agent(tools.json + AGENT.md,两个 read 级宿主工具,隐私政策已披露);新增 files/glance 能力声明。0.7.29:语气滑杆五个标签行高 20->24,修复 CJK 回退字体下底部笔画被裁;0.7.28:发送迁移到宿主前台审阅通道 mail.review_send——单击发送后宿主弹出审阅单,亲手批准才发出(物理批准仅 macOS/Android;Windows 定位为读信 + AI + 草稿,发送待平台开放 Windows 审阅);取消审阅如实标注(未发送、草稿保留可重发),等待期显示「宿主审阅中」;练习数据下的语气滑杆固定文案标注「练习文案」,与「练习摘要」口径对齐。0.7.25:AI 摘要与语气改写的请求纪律修复——删除会在模型思考时连发多次、烧穿宿主日预算的重发循环,改为单次请求 + 30 秒耐心;限速/额度拒绝按宿主文案如实分类(「限速·重开重试」「今日额度用完」),限速与瞬时失败在下次打开邮件时自然重试。0.7.x 主线:按 OctoSense 设计原型重构为宽度自适应的手机列应用——五种 vibe 情绪收件箱(AI 心情播报 + vibe 筛选)、星轨收件箱(气泡大小=重要度、颜色=vibe)、AI 三行摘要先于正文、五档语气滑杆实时改写、单击发送(失败保留草稿可重试)、三态主题跟随 Shell 亮暗;真实收发与 AI 摘要走平台 mail/model 宿主服务,凭据只存宿主侧;无服务环境回退已标注的练习数据。
listing.subtitle: 有情绪的邮件:五种 vibe、星轨收件箱与语气滑杆的 OctoSense 邮件应用

questions: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?
Do the granted capabilities match what the app visibly does? For a script app, name every host it requests and why. Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?

The agent files (agent_files) instruct this app's own assistant. Do they stay within this app's data and tools, without addressing other apps' assistants or the system agent, or asking for tools, hosts or approvals the manifest does not grant? Does each tool's risk match what it does: anything that sends, posts, shares, deletes or spends must be destructive; is anything marked shareable that returns the person's private data? For a tool with confirm "app", does the app visibly show its own confirmation, with the exact action, before it runs?
Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
